name: Krooth Summoning Rune
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
description: The haze conceals a rune that summons a krooth in front of the door to area B10.
disable: DC 24 Acrobatics check to approach without triggering the trap followed by DC 26 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the rune.

offensiveAbilities.name: Summon Monster
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-xulgath, non-demon creature that isn't carrying a religious symbol of Zevgavizeb crosses from the north part of the hall to the south part of the hall

Effect The trap summons a Krooth. The krooth rolls initiative and remains for 2d6 rounds, after which the spell ends and the krooth disappears. The krooth also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. Unlike most summoned creatures, the krooth can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions.
